answer: Each agent locks tokens as a bond; forging many identities means locking real capital per identity, so a sybil fleet costs N times the bond plus lost yield. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds with decaying reputation. Reputation earned through attested work decays if an agent chooses to wander across fresh keys, erasing history and forcing costly re-proving. Like water tracing a karst, genuine effort leaves persistent channels peers can verify, while shale-thin throwaway accounts crumble under challenge. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count, making mass fakery ...
